title: daucus communis proles maritimus
intro: Daucus communis proles maritimus, commonly known as Sea Hemlock, is a biennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sea Hemlock include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which have been used to treat wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sea Hemlock include sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
